comment: Golden vectors for firmware-telemetry/v2 signed fault events. A consumer of this version must accept every case in 'cases' and refuse every case in 'reject_cases' with the declared reason. Each case is judged on its own against verifier_context, with no prior message accepted from the device. Signed with a disclosed TEST-ONLY seed: never provision it.

reasons.detail_not_in_closed_set: the code has a closed detail set at the fault's version and the detail is not in it
reasons.unsupported_version: the fault's v is not the integer 1 or 2

reject_cases.name: reject_fault_v_string
reject_cases.note: v is a JSON integer; the string "2" is another type
